name: MAX dimerization protein MGA

function.text: MGA encodes MAX gene-associated protein. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity, RNA polymerase II-specific and protein dimerization activity. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription and positive regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: No constitutional disease assertion was retrieved in the reviewed GenCC snapshot; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Gastrointestinal NUT-rearranged sarcoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.
